atoms.text: Aoife is a Northern Irish tour guide. Will you explore Northern Ireland with her?

instruction.text: Aoife asks if you know where Northern Ireland is. Select the UK map with Northern Ireland highlighted.

feedback.correct: This is Northern Ireland! Northern Ireland is the smallest country in the UK and is on a separate island from the other UK countries. It shares this island with the Republic of Ireland.

instruction.text: The tour will start and end in Northern Ireland’s capital city. Answer Aoife’s question.

atoms.a: “What is the name of Northern Ireland’s capital city?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1Ie'>What is the name of Northern Ireland’s capital city?</voice>

instruction.text: Answer Aoife’s question using the map.

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter E means east, and the letter W means west.

atoms.a: “Are we starting our tour from the east or west of Northern Ireland?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1Ie'>Are we starting our tour from the east or west of Northern Ireland?</voice>

instruction.text: Aoife wants to know if you recognise the sights of Northern Ireland. Select the images of places in Northern Ireland.

feedback.wrong: This is the Arctic Ocean. The seas around Northern Ireland are not cold enough to have floating ice sheets.

instruction.text: Aoife wants to show you around both the cities and landscapes of Northern Ireland. Drag the images to the correct group.

feedback.finish: Northern Ireland has a population of just under 2 million people. It is the least populated country in the UK.
